units.categoryReason: Recruiters locate and review applications by candidate, position, and stage, then advance or close individual applications as operational work items.

moleculeReasons.desktop: Recommendations use available collection display, record display, selection, text-entry, notification, progress, and command candidates that match the declared queries, input setters, statuses, and commands.
moleculeReasons.mobile: Recommendations preserve the same declared display, selection, text-entry, notification, progress, and command capabilities while prioritizing concise reading order and touch-operable interaction on constrained screens.

units.categoryReason: This page maintains the organization-wide candidate master records that recruiters locate and register for use in hiring applications.

moleculeReasons.desktop: Recommendations use the available candidates for candidate lookup and result display, supported registration text entry, and the create-candidate command with its feedback and loading states.
moleculeReasons.mobile: Recommendations retain all lookup and registration capabilities on mobile while favoring touch-friendly search, compact record reading, accessible data entry, and clear command feedback.

units.categoryReason: The Home page is a hiring-manager command center that brings together remaining headcount, decision backlog, position and offer highlights, and time-sensitive deadlines.

moleculeReasons.desktop: Recommendations use the available query-compatible metric, collection, progress, and notification groups; no unprovided hiring-decision action is assumed.
moleculeReasons.mobile: Recommendations preserve the same query capability while favoring compact, touch-readable metric and record displays plus accessible loading and error feedback.

units.categoryReason: The page supports hiring-position lifecycle work: retrieving positions, opening a position with an assigned hiring manager, reviewing staffing context, and communicating the closure condition when staffing is complete. No published category specifically represents hiring-position lifecycle management; an operations queue does not cover the position-creation and staffing-record focus.

moleculeReasons.desktop: Recommendations use compatible listed candidates for the available job-position query, creation inputs and command, its feedback states, and the declared closure-event information.
moleculeReasons.mobile: Recommendations retain the same supported job-position query and creation capabilities, favoring compact, touch-friendly candidates while preserving accessible feedback and event context.

units.categoryReason: The hiring manager looks up applications on managed positions by status, reviews related candidate and position details, and advances eligible applications through offer or hire decisions.

moleculeReasons.desktop: The catalog provides compatible candidates for declared record queries, their loading and error feedback, editable lookup values, and contextual offer and hire commands.
moleculeReasons.mobile: The same declared query and command capabilities remain available on mobile; the catalog provides touch-suitable lookup, record-display, progress, feedback, and action candidates without removing any capability.

units.categoryReason: The page helps a hiring manager locate managed job positions and offered applications by status, inspect current hiring need, and perform the available hiring transition. This is operational work organized around status and follow-up decisions.

moleculeReasons.desktop: Recommendations align with the declared editable position lookup, collection result, derived headcount values, and query-status feedback. No command trigger is recommended for the list because its declared capabilities do not expose a pagination command or other matching trigger capability.
moleculeReasons.mobile: Mobile preserves every declared lookup and query capability while prioritizing headcount and status feedback for constrained reading space. Recommendations are limited to groups supported by those capabilities; no closure-event history is available.

units.categoryReason: This recruiter home is intended to monitor hiring KPIs, near-capacity positions, deadlines, and work needing attention; that purpose aligns with a dashboard command center. The shared implementation currently supplies a JobPosition query, including filled and remaining headcount, which supports the position-focused monitoring portion.

moleculeReasons.desktop: Recommendations use only the declared JobPosition query and its loading/error states. No application, deadline, recurring-duty, rejection, or closure capability is available.
moleculeReasons.mobile: Recommendations preserve the same declared query capability and its status feedback on mobile; constrained space does not create application, deadline, recurring-duty, rejection, or closure capabilities.
